source.author: ov
source.text: Non impune feres rector maris inquit et omnes inclinavit aquas ad avarae litora Troiae, inque freti formam terras complevit opesque abstulit agricolis et fluctibus obruit agros.
source.text_original: 'Non impune feres' rector maris inquit et omnes / inclinavit aquas ad avarae litora Troiae, / inque freti formam terras complevit opesque / abstulit agricolis et fluctibus obruit agros.
source.text_english: You will not carry this off unpunished, said the ruler of the sea, and he turned all the waters toward the greedy shores of Troy, and filled the lands into the shape of a strait, and removed their wealth from the farmers, and buried the fields beneath the waves.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tibi, rector aquarum, summus honor, tibi caeruleis in litore vittis et Zephyris Glaucoque bovem Thetidique iuvencam deicit Ancaeus.
reuse.text_original: tibi, rector aquarum, / summus honor, tibi caeruleis in litore vittis / et Zephyris Glaucoque bovem Thetidique iuvencam / deicit Ancaeus.
reuse.text_english: For you, ruler of the waters, the highest honor; for you, on the shore with blue fillets, Ancaeus casts down a bull to Zephyrus and Glaucus, and a heifer to Thetis.
